title: Evidence-semantics contract for a sensor ingest path
description: A machine-readable statement of what an ingest path is allowed to do to the QUALITY coordinate of an observation E = (x, q). It says nothing about numerical accuracy. NOTE: this schema is a research artifact. It is not a standard, it is not proposed as one, and every field below is a restatement of distinctions that already exist in ARINC 429 SSM, NAMUR NE 107, OPC UA StatusCode and the SQL null literature -- see PRIOR_ART_MATRIX.md.

source.description: protocol/message the input states are read from

accepted_input_states.description: canonical evidence states the SOURCE can present, with the exact raw condition that produces each

emitted_states_required.description: states the path MUST be able to emit downstream. A state that appears here and is absent from the path's measured output vocabulary is a contract failure regardless of any trace.

allowed_merges.description: pairs the path MAY map to one downstream state, each with the reason the distinction does not matter to the declared downstream property. A merge is not a defect on its own -- item 9.

forbidden_merges.description: pairs that MUST remain distinguishable, each with the downstream consumer that needs the distinction and a witness word per state

needed_by.description: the declared downstream property, cited to source

witness_words.description: canonical input word that realises each state

stage_sites.description: pipeline stage -> the file:line the checker should name when the collapse is localised there

state.description: V observed-valid, I observed-invalid, N not-observed, S stale, X sentinel/explicit-not-measured, R retained-after-disavowal, M imputed, E estimator-derived. See CANONICAL_STATE_MODEL.md.
